mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `tenant` ( tenant_code, tenant_name, status, owner_user_id, description, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantCode}, #{tenantName}, #{status}, #{ownerUserId}, #{description}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_code, tenant_name, status, owner_user_id, description, created_at, updated_at FROM `tenant` WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, tenant_code, tenant_name, status, owner_user_id, description, created_at, updated_at FROM `tenant` WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, tenant_code, tenant_name, status, owner_user_id, description, created_at, updated_at FROM `tenant` WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} ORDER BY id DESC
